covers: Tuesday 17 November 2026 from 06:00 to 13:15 SAST (JSE session to midday, market levels as of 12:36), with Monday's closes for reference
headline: JSE falls 1.2% as it follows Wall Street lower; Telkom lifts interim HEPS 9.3%; Nvidia reports tonight
summary: The JSE All Share was 1.2% lower at 110,164 at midday on Tuesday, following Monday's sell-off on Wall Street, with the rand at R16.94/$ and platinum down 2.3% on the day (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 17 Nov 2026 12:36 SAST). Telkom reported revenue up 2.0% to R22.5bn and HEPS up 9.3% to 334.1c for the six months to 30 September 2026, a day after confirming an early-stage takeover approach from MTN (Telkom SENS via InsidEntity; TechCentral, 17 Nov 2026). On Monday the S&P 500 closed 1.9% lower and the Nasdaq 2.5% lower; Nvidia's results later today, SA CPI on Wednesday and the SARB decision on Thursday are the next tests (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), close 16 Nov 2026).

items.title: S&P 500 closes 1.9% lower at 7,416.59; Nasdaq -2.5% at 24,509.76
items.summary: Monday's closes, against Friday 13 November: S&P 500 7,416.59 (Friday 7,561.67, -1.9%); Nasdaq Composite 24,509.76 (Friday 25,136.27, -2.5%). The fall built on the weak open reported in last night's update, when chip stocks led the market down.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^GSPC, ^IXIC daily close), 16 Nov 2026

items.title: US 10-year yield 5.12%
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield closed at 5.121% on Monday, slightly below Friday's 5.154%. The October FOMC minutes are due on Wednesday.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^TNX daily close), 16 Nov 2026

items.title: Telkom interim: revenue +2.0% to R22.5bn, HEPS +9.3% to 334.1c, no interim dividend
items.summary: For the six months to 30 September 2026 Telkom's group revenue rose 2.0% to R22,537m and EBITDA 5.8% to R6,375m (margin 28.3%); HEPS rose 9.3% to 334.1c and free cash flow 37.8% to R998m. No interim dividend was declared, in line with its annual payout policy. Mobile service revenue grew 4% to R11.5bn and fibre homes connected rose 15.1% to 870,856, while BCX revenue fell 8.2%. On MTN, the results repeat Monday's cautionary: talks are at an early stage and there is no certainty a deal will happen. Telkom is not on the LRC coverage list.
items.source: Telkom SENS via InsidEntity, 17 Nov 2026 09:01; TechCentral, 17 Nov 2026 07:39

items.title: JSE All Share 1.2% lower at 110,164 by midday; Top 40 at 102,266
items.summary: At 12:36 SAST on Tuesday the All Share was at 110,164.36, down 1.2% from Monday's close of 111,525.58, and the Top 40 at 102,265.67, down 1.3% from 103,628.96. The market is following Monday's falls on Wall Street, with weaker platinum and gold weighing on miners.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^J203.JO, ^J200.JO), 17 Nov 2026 12:36 SAST; Monday close 16 Nov 2026

items.title: CPI on Wednesday, SARB on Thursday
items.summary: October CPI is due on Wednesday 18 November (September: 4.5%) and the SARB announces its decision on Thursday 19 November with the repo rate at 7.25%. A Reuters poll quoted on Monday expected October CPI at 5.1%.
items.source: Reuters via CNBC Africa, 16 Nov 2026 08:56 GMT; LRC Market Dashboard, 13 Nov 2026

items.title: Nvidia reports today under interim CEO Colette Kress
items.summary: Nvidia reports quarterly results on Tuesday 17 November, its first since Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO last week. Analysts expect revenue up 91% to $108.93bn (TipRanks, 16 Nov 2026). The shares were at $158.70 in early trade on Monday, below our $262.56 fair value. Our BUY rating is unchanged; the results, not the leadership news, are the real test of it.
items.source: City AM, 16 Nov 2026 14:38 GMT; TipRanks, 16 Nov 2026

items.title: AMD fell with the chip group on Monday
items.summary: AMD was down 5.1% at Monday's open after an 8.8% fall on Friday. Our SELL rating is unchanged.
